anomalies: WTA discrimination actually improved slightly: 52.9mV margin (new) vs 50.9mV (baseline). This is because the R-based reference produces 0.996uA vs exactly 1.0uA, which systematically shifts all mirror currents by -0.4%. The nonlinear interaction slightly favors class 2 discrimination.

V(pbias_master_p) differs by -1.46mV from ideal. This is due to NFET channel-length modulation (Vds mismatch: mirror NFET at Vds≈1.2V vs diode NFET at Vds≈0.62V). The error is within tolerance but could be reduced with longer L mirror if needed.
regression_check: PASS — WTA outputs within 1.5mV of baseline for all 5 classes
recommendations: MAJOR-008 classifier portion is COMPLETE. Proceed to MAJOR-007 (frontend+classifier integration) or MAJOR-006 (energy recompute).
For tapeout: consider replacing R_bias_n with a SKY130 high-res poly resistor (sky130_fd_pr__res_high_po). R=1.182MOhm requires ~591 squares at 2kOhm/sq.
For better supply rejection: replace R-based reference with beta-multiplier. Not needed for simulation validation.
